title: give the UI pass a sandbox-safe way to render CLI command output, such as a test helper that prints the output to a file in the temp dir

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-230547-39fc, project ork, item S339:

give the UI pass a sandbox-safe way to render CLI command output, such as a test helper that prints the output to a file in the temp dir

Evidence: the renders for projects add had to be built from the strings the tests assert, because running the real binary would contact the owner's live daemon
